craft_notes: Sthāyin: confessed cheating. Device: dashes→commas (abiding stated softly throughout). Rejected: 'fooled' for gulled — killed: gulled older, nearer vañcita. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: In the twinless, the traceless, in thee, the Self abiding, Lord,
we yet are gulled by thy bottomless beguilement.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava

reads_against.argmap: In nondual, in limitless — in you, in self being, O lord.; We are cheated even now by your unmeasured māyā. → Though you are nondual self, your māyā cheats us still.
c1_essence: No substitute past strands; nondual self yet cheating glamour; wish-tree sprouts powers, lordship, ending.
reads_against.l2: Nondual you are, boundless self, O lord — and still your fathomless glamour fools us now.
l3: In the twinless, the traceless — in thee, the Self abiding, Lord —
we yet are gulled by thy bottomless beguilement.
reads_against.t1: Though you, the self, are nondual and limitless, O lord — even now we are cheated by your unmeasured māyā.
